description: Search local business profiles on Bezal by name, category, or location. Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos and coordinates are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only for providers on a higher paid plan.

query.description: Free-text search across business name and description

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name

name: search_businesses
title: Search businesses
